body:
Works alongside the adventurers and acknowledges their success after the fight.

Recorded role and choices

During the 21 January 2025 voyage and expedition, Carlie is initially watchful and reserved, helps get the ship underway, and later urges the party to collect the goods and check on the captain. Her final praise marks a visible change in her treatment of the company. The selected scene does not supply a larger career or identify her with every unnamed pirate proxy.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
